prompt: We're evaluating a new customer success program we rolled out to different regions at different times over 18 months — 15 regions got it in Q1, 20 in Q3, and 10 in Q4. We ran a standard two-way fixed-effects (TWFE) regression with region and quarter fixed effects, and the coefficient on 'treated' is +6% on renewal rate. A reviewer says 'TWFE with staggered rollout can give biased estimates even when parallel trends holds — is that right, and should I be worried?
